texts: Decaf coffee still contains 2-5mg of caffeine per cup — so if you're highly sensitive, you might still feel a tiny buzz from your "caffeine-free" drink.
A fungal disease called coffee rust caused $3 billion in damages and wiped out enough beans to make 6 billion cups during a 2012-2013 Central American epidemic.
Pink bourbon is a rare coffee variety with mutations causing cherries to ripen pink instead of red — only about 5,000 pounds exist globally, making it one of the world's rarest coffees.
